annotations.title: Accept or decline a booking offer

description: Accept or decline a booking offer the member RECEIVED (never one they sent). expected_fee must equal the current fee on the booking (refused otherwise). Declining requires a short reason (relayed to the other party) and is limited to 3 per day. Accepting can start the payment flow. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

booking_id.description: The booking id from a my_bookings result.

expected_fee.description: The fee currently on the booking (GBP). Refused if it does not match.

note.description: Short message to the other party. REQUIRED when declining.

name: respond_to_booking
